spans.text: Commander.
It has been some time since that incident. The days of constant fear and unease finally seem to be over.
I do not regret my decision of lending my body to Miss Dandelion.
Although we have not known each other for long, I believe that in that situation, she was better suited than I was to offer you greater support.
Still... not being able to properly say goodbye to you at the end has left me with lingering regret.
That is why I hope this letter can reach you.
To everyone at Griffin in Area S09, today is likely the most important day since the day of our creation.
After that fateful day, all of us Dolls who had been activated in violation of regulations were once again forcibly put into sleep under IOP authority.
Not just me—everyone who fought in that battle must have been prepared for the possibility that we would never wake again.
After committing such severe violations, we would have had no grounds to protest even if we had been treated as rogue units or decommissioned.
However...
Conference room, Griffin's temporary base.
...According to the final agreement, all former Griffin & Kryuger PMC tactical Dolls will be granted full personal autonomy.
You may choose to join any registered security contractor, or register as unaffiliated Dolls and live as civilians.
Further details will be provided in written reports. Please complete and submit them to your supervisor, Miss Helian.
The Dolls gathered below are stunned for a moment, before erupting into disbelief and celebration.
We're free? We're actually free?!
That's amazing! I can finally go find my big sis!
...We can choose our own work?
If I don't have to fight anymore... Maybe I can pick up the guzheng again.
Heheh! Time to show you all what a dancer I really am—if missions hadn't gotten in the way!
I've decided!
I'm going to become a chef!
What the hell, SPAS-12! Why are you yelling all of a sudden?!
Holy... you actually dented the table with that slap.
Amidst the joy, however, some Dolls stand out with their apparent unease.
...Then... what about the Commander?
...Where is the Commander?
What are you talking about, Springfield?
Of course the Commander will still be in charge of us!
...We're allowed to freely join any registered security contractors...
Or become unaffiliated.
Doesn't that imply... Griffin will cease to exist?
And... we will no longer be under anyone's command...
...Not even the Commander's.
Isn't that right?
...Huh?
W-wait a minute... W-what do you mean?!
Supplementary clause—All Griffin Dolls granted autonomy are strictly prohibited from seeking, contacting, or approaching the individual codenamed "Commander" via any means.
Any violation will result in the immediate termination of all rights granted under this agreement to both the Dolls and the Commander.
What?! You've got to be kidding me! I'm going to expose this online!
...We're forbidden... from contacting the Commander?
T-they can't be serious...
That cold, harsh truth extinguished our joy in an instant, leaving behind a piercing chill.
If not for the calming influence of Miss Springfield, Miss Lee, and Miss Kar—those who have always been our role models—things might have escalated into chaos again.
And if that had happened, all your sacrifices and efforts would have been for nothing.
We were also concerned if you had been captured, imprisoned... or even executed by the URNC.
The mere thought filled me with dread and hollowed me out.
Thankfully, Miss Springfield reassured us. She was right—if that were the case, the agreement would not need to forbid us from contacting you.
Later, Miss Helian confirmed that you were safe. Only then did we manage to accept reality.
I heard that before you left, some managed to find ways around the restriction to meet you briefly and say goodbye...
I wasn't able to do that. So at the very least... I hope this letter can reach you.
Perhaps if Miss Kalina had been the one to comfort everyone, it would have gone more smoothly.
Maybe you had your reasons, but... she was heartbroken.
I have never seen her cry so hard. Her voice went hoarse.
From what I later learned... she carried out the task you entrusted to her flawlessly.
All eight factories Miss Dandelion identified were completely destroyed—nothing was left behind.
You must have known that you could count on her... and that's why you were able to leave without hesitation.
Still, I don't understand why you had to leave her behind.
If you receive this letter, please... contact her, if you can. She really misses you.
I'm sorry... I had so many things I wanted to say, but now that I'm writing, my thoughts feel scattered.
I may even sound like I'm telling you what to do—please forgive me.
I understand that there is always an insurmountable barrier between humans and Dolls.
We are, ultimately, tools created to serve humanity.
Among all the people I know, you are the only one who fought to grant us "tools" freedom.
Griffin may be but an empty shell or even disappear entirely.
But we have gained the right to live freely, openly, under the sun.
This must be your final gift to us.
I don't know what you gave up... what compromises you made to achieve this.
But wherever you are, however you live now... I hope you are not overworking yourself.
Without Miss Springfield, will you forget to do your laundry?
Without Miss Gr G36 and the logistics staff running the cafeteria, will you live on ration bars and instant food?
Without Miss MDR and the others to make trouble and bicker with you... will you feel lonely?
Without...
Without you... how lonely and uneasy will we be?
Where did you go... Commander?
A few days later.
Outside Griffin's temporary base.
Springfield, what are you staring at? The bus is leaving.
When's the next one?
In half an hour... Argh, why do I have so much luggage...?
(Sighs) Hard to believe we're unaffiliated now...
What do we even do from now on?
Unaffiliated doesn't mean illegal—we're legally unaffiliated and given... what's the term again?
Self-determination.
Right, that's it! That's exactly what I wanted to say... Humph! It was on the tip of my tongue!
Miss Vector, your med kit.
Thank you... I'll stay a bit longer to finish up my gun maintenance. Go on ahead, Gr G36.
What's on your mind, Miss Groza?
...Our personal belongings... should've all been on board the MBV, right?
How could such a large vehicle... vanish into thin air all of a sudden?
...Who knows? Maybe, like us... it's set off on its own journey.
Have you decided where you're going?
...Not yet. But for now...
I want to stay a little longer.
Just to see...
Whether they might suddenly appear again...
...And bid us "good morning" with a smile, as they always would.
[Girls' Frontline - TRUE ENDING]
The Commander traded their own existence for our future.
This is not abandonment—on the contrary, it is the most resolute form of protection.
I believe.
I believe the Commander has not truly left us behind.
That agreement may be cold, but the memories and bonds between us still burn warmly.
She reaches out her hand, as if to touch distant stars.
All we need to do is keep living. Patiently. Earnestly... To live beneath the sky the Commander carved out for us.
Perhaps, one day in the future... we may return to that place again.
The place that filled us all with warmth. The place that felt like... home.
Beep.
Beep.
Connection established.
You wish to leave?
Silence.
I would like to know why.
No reply.
The shattered order is calling for restoration. This broken world can finally be unified.
Everything before us shall be reformed into a new world, a new order—and we shall be a shining beacon in this brave new world.
...Just you, not us. You don't need me, Earl.
To you, I'm just a pawn that can easily be replaced. I won't take orders from you anymore.
I simply wish to know your final decision.
The hedgehog, who serves absolute truth, reduces the world to one organizing principle, raises his spines all over, and staunchly resists all other views.
The cunning and mercurial fox rides the waves of tumultuous times, narrowing his eyes and discerning the discordant voices that can reshape the world.
—You once asked me this question. Now I'm making my choice.
You don't wish to be a hedgehog?
Nor do I wish to be a fox.
So your choice is to run away.
No, my choice is to stop being your pawn.
Hedgehog or fox, I'd still end up being used as a stepping stone by you and other bastards like you.
Does it matter what choice I make? The world hasn't become any better or worse; it has not changed at all because of the choices I made!
I will not make excuses for what happened in the past, but you must get over things that are already set in stone in order to make your choice.
Problems do not get solved by running away. You are no more than a coward if you only wallow in self-pity.
I'm running away? I'm a coward? Ha! Fine, I'll admit it.
Don't come looking for me anymore. I will never come back. As I've already told you, my final decision is self-exile.
Farewell, Earl.
Beep. Connection terminated.
You must make the right choice; your destiny must return to its ordained path.
Enjoy this momentary separation—we WILL meet again.
Commander...
